result.instructions: Tools for Imker SalesCRM, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which products in my shop are sold out, and which are still active?"; "Show me the orders placed this week that are not paid yet."; "Create a 15 percent discount code for my newsletter subscribers, valid until the end of the month.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Imker SalesCRM data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run imkersalescrm_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run imkersalescrm_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run imkersalescrm_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. imkersalescrm_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: imkersalescrm_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List the products in the shop with price, VAT rate, active state, category and stock fields (in_stock, reserved, available). Filter by active state, category or name/SKU. Imker API: GET /api/v1/products.

category_id.description: Only products in this category id.

search.description: Search by product name or SKU.

tools.name: imkersalescrm_get_product
tools.title: Get product
tools.description: Get one product by id, with its full description, stock fields and category ids. Imker API: GET /api/v1/products/:id.

tools.name: imkersalescrm_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: List orders with paging and filters: status id, internal status (placed, canceled, returned), payment status, date range, customer email, product id or SKU, and updated_since to fetch only changed orders. Use updated_since with the time of your last run to poll for changes. Imker API: GET /api/v1/orders.

customer_email.description: Only orders of this customer email.

product_id.description: One id or several separated by commas, for example 12,17,33.

sku.description: One SKU or several separated by commas.

updated_since.description: Only orders changed since this time (ISO 8601, or YYYY-MM-DD for local midnight). Wrong format returns an error.

include_details.description: true = include order items, addresses and costs in each order.

tools.name: imkersalescrm_get_order
tools.title: Get order
tools.description: Get one order with its items, addresses, costs, notes and attributes. The uuid field is an access secret for the order's cart; do not share it. Imker API: GET /api/v1/orders/:id.

tools.name: imkersalescrm_list_order_statuses
tools.title: List order statuses
tools.description: List the visible order statuses with their ids. Use an id when you filter orders by status. Imker API: GET /api/v1/order_statuses.

tools.name: imkersalescrm_list_delivery_types
tools.title: List delivery types
tools.description: List the delivery types with their ids. Use an id in discount codes that cover delivery. Imker API: GET /api/v1/delivery_types.

tools.name: imkersalescrm_list_discount_codes
tools.title: List discount codes
tools.description: List discount codes with type, value, limits, usage count, validity dates and active state. Filter by type, active state or code/name. Imker API: GET /api/v1/discount_codes.

tools.name: imkersalescrm_get_discount_code
tools.title: Get discount code
tools.description: Get one discount code by id with all its rules. Imker API: GET /api/v1/discount_codes/:id.

tools.name: imkersalescrm_create_discount_code
tools.title: Create discount code
tools.description: Create a discount code that customers can use at checkout. It goes live at once unless start_date is in the future. Needs a key with the write_data scope. Imker API: POST /api/v1/discount_codes.

code.description: Discount code. Must be unique in the shop.

value.description: Discount amount or percentage. Required for percentage and value discounts. For unit_price_discount, it is the target unit price.

name.description: Internal name (shown only in the admin panel).

case_sensitive.description: Whether the code is case-sensitive (default true).

minimum_quantity.description: Minimum number of products the code covers (from 2).

usages_limit.description: Maximum number of uses in total.

usages_per_customer_limit.description: Maximum number of uses per customer.

combine_with_other_discount.description: Whether other discounts may apply together with this code (default true).

product_ids.description: Product ids, used with selected_products or products_except.

product_category_ids.description: Category ids, used with selected_categories or categories_except.

relation_with_delivery_types.description: Which delivery types the code covers (see imkersalescrm_list_delivery_types).

tools.name: imkersalescrm_update_discount_code
tools.title: Update discount code
tools.description: Change a discount code. Send only the fields to change. Needs a key with the write_data scope. Imker API: PATCH /api/v1/discount_codes/:id.

code.description: Discount code. Must be unique in the shop.

value.description: Discount amount or percentage. Required for percentage and value discounts. For unit_price_discount, it is the target unit price.

name.description: Internal name (shown only in the admin panel).

case_sensitive.description: Whether the code is case-sensitive (default true).

minimum_quantity.description: Minimum number of products the code covers (from 2).

usages_limit.description: Maximum number of uses in total.

usages_per_customer_limit.description: Maximum number of uses per customer.

combine_with_other_discount.description: Whether other discounts may apply together with this code (default true).

product_ids.description: Product ids, used with selected_products or products_except.

product_category_ids.description: Category ids, used with selected_categories or categories_except.

relation_with_delivery_types.description: Which delivery types the code covers (see imkersalescrm_list_delivery_types).

tools.name: imkersalescrm_get_sales_report
tools.title: Get sales report
tools.description: Get the number and sum of orders placed in a date range (canceled and returned orders are left out), optionally grouped by day, week or month. The range may span up to 1830 days. Imker API: GET /api/v1/reports/sales.

product_id.description: One id or several separated by commas, for example 12,17,33.

sku.description: Only products with this SKU (or several, comma-separated).

customer_email.description: Only orders of this customer email.
